description: Owners only (needs sign-in): When the owner decides not to pay a plan checkout started with receptionist_checkout (billing.pending_checkout in receptionist_service): expires its Stripe checkout link, so it can no longer be paid, and drops what it held: the waiting plan, its price counted against the spending cap, and the cap it would have raised. Charges nothing and leaves the spending cap as the owner set it. A paid plan is cancelled in receptionist_billing_portal instead. Returns canceled and the updated receptionist_service view.
name: cancel_receptionist_checkout
title: Cancel my unpaid plan checkout
